tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List the marketplaces TicketsData supports, the URL or ID format each one expects, which ones support event discovery and cross-market comparison, and valid mode values. Free: uses no credits. Call this first when unsure how to format an input.

tools.name: get_event_listings
tools.description: Fetch live ticket listings for ONE event on ONE marketplace: section, row, quantity, price and fees. Real time, not cached. Costs 1 API credit per call. Returns the complete TicketsData API response, unchanged: always as a link to a JSON file, and also inline (whole when small, otherwise the first p

tools.name: find_events
tools.description: List upcoming events for a performer, artist, team, organizer or venue page on one marketplace. Use it to discover event URLs, then pass one to get_event_listings or compare_marketplaces. Real time, costs 1 API credit. Returns the complete TicketsData API response, unchanged: always as a link to a J

tools.name: compare_marketplaces
tools.description: Cross-market report for ONE event. Give any marketplace's event URL: TicketsData finds the same event on the other marketplaces, fetches all of them live, and returns matched URLs, normalized listings per marketplace, per-market price and fee summaries, the cheapest all-in entry point and per-sectio

tools.name: analyze_listings
tools.description: Work on the COMPLETE response of an earlier get_event_listings, compare_marketplaces or find_events call, including items too many to show inline.
